title: RFP compliance matrix + submission gate
description: Split cited requirements, prepare responses in parallel, collect evidence, and gate submission.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: rfp-compliance-submission-gate
  title: RFP compliance matrix + submission gate
  description: Split cited requirements, prepare responses in parallel, collect evidence, and gate submission.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Split cited requirements, prepare responses in parallel, collect evidence, and gate submission.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Solicitation Requirements Analyst
      templateRef: pub-01
      role: Solicitation Requirements Analyst operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval
        boundaries.
      prompt: Extract every solicitation requirement with citation, type, owner, evidence, and submission
        consequence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Compliance Matrix Builder
      templateRef: pub-02
      role: Compliance Matrix Builder operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Build a complete requirement-to-response matrix and expose every missing or conflicting response
        obligation.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Cost Realism Analyst
      templateRef: pub-04
      role: Cost Realism Analyst operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Test proposed cost against scope, labor, schedule, assumptions, risk, and the solicitation basis
        without inventing rates.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - risk-analysis
          - quantitative-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: requirements
      kind: transform
      name: Split cited requirements
      config:
        operation: slice
        expression: $.requirements[0:200]
    - id: work-group
      kind: group
      name: Bounded specialist phase
      config:
        members:
          - role-1
          - role-2
          - role-3
        execution: parallel
        exit: aggregate
    - id: collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect compliant responses
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable domain reviewer approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: requirements
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: requirements
      to: work-group
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: work-group
      to: collect
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: collect
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e5
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
